articles.title: Media Advisory - Rural municipal leaders headed to Toronto for 2026 ROMA Conference
articles.mainIdea: Media Advisory - Rural municipal leaders headed to Toronto for 2026 ROMA Conference
articles.summary: CNW Group: Media Advisory - Rural municipal leaders headed to Toronto for 2026 ROMA Conference. More than 1,900 participants from more than 300 municipalities and organizations across Ontario will gather in Toronto for the 2026 Rural Ontario Municipal Association (ROMA) Annual Conference, taking place from January 18 to 20 at the Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel.
